dimensions: Multiply each nominal rectangular B/H in the chosen group by the catalog factors. Round updated b,h in m to 6 decimal places, then compute A=b*h, Iy=b*h^3/12, Iz=h*b^3/12; let a=max(b,h),t=min(b,h), J=a*t^3*(1/3-0.21*t/a*(1-t^4/(12*a^4))). Update both shape B/H in mm and properties. Do not change E/G or coordinates.
objective: Minimize total upper+primary material volume among feasible designs; if none feasible, report the design minimizing maximum constraint utilization.
